prompt_variants.action: Sigrid arranges materials in final pattern: sheep rib north-south, industrial rope coiled beside it, brass button at center, wool in handful. Opens book - pages yellow, some Danish replacing Old Norse, water damage making words swim. Her hand protective on belly, feeling movement - baby responding to mother's voice. Traces finger along first line of incantation. Takes breath, breaks her silence: "Ð‰g verð að bjarga barninu." Voice young, desperate, but clear. Years of enforced silence breaking like dam. Guðrún's head snaps up, shocked to hear daughter speak. Empty clothes lean forward. House breathing catches, holds at inhale. Through window, trawler beam passes, illuminating her face - determination and terror mixed. Book shows illustration: tilberi creature suckling, but margins have industrial additions - gears, pipes, contamination even in drawings.
prompt_variants.style: Close on Sigrid's face as silence breaks, pull back to show materials (that's where the camera is), documentary of threshold moment.
